title: Getting Started with lassoboot
text: lassoboot answers question: predictors actually matter, given measured known instrument uncertainty? Standard lasso regression assumes predictors measured exactly. practice, every sensor, balance, test method introduces noise. noise substantial relative predictor range — 4 % coefficient variation concrete strength test, 0.07 wt % standard deviation XRF alumina measurement — inflates uncertainty coefficient estimates can cause predictors selected dropped inconsistently across replicates. lassoboot propagates declared measurement uncertainties parametric bootstrap: B iterations predictors perturbed declared noise, response regenerated fitted model, lasso refit. result selection probability (fraction iterations predictor retained) stability score (max selection probability across regularization path), informative single regularized point estimate.

Default NULL. intercept Logical. Fit intercept? Passed engine. Default TRUE. standardize Logical. Standardize predictors? Passed engine. Default TRUE. precision precision level use lb_uncertainty() declares two levels.
